clue.text: Connection between two City banks?

parts.note: read 'banks' as the two riverbanks of the Thames at the City of London rather than financial institutions, and the connection is a crossing between them

explanation.surface: A financier asks what links two banks in London's financial district.
explanation.walkthrough: The City is London's financial district, so 'banks' looks like money; the river banks of the Thames there are joined by a famous crossing.
explanation.definitionFit: The bridge spans the Thames between the City of London on the north bank and Southwark on the south.

clue.text: Opportunity to ring writer in Gateshead

parts.note: a ring is round like the letter O
a pen is a writing instrument
taken as written
read as Gate's head, the first letter of 'gate'

explanation.surface: A chance to phone an author in the north-eastern town of Gateshead.
explanation.walkthrough: Gateshead is a town in north-east England, but here it splits as 'Gate's head', the letter G.
explanation.definitionFit: An opening is a favourable chance, as in a job vacancy or a gap to exploit.

clue.text: Unable to hear a fellow needed to turn round

indicators.note: the rearranged letters go round, enclosing the other piece
the word needed is turned about, its letters rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone who cannot hear needed a man to turn around to face them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to turn' rearranges the letters of 'needed', and 'round' makes them wrap around the A and F; the surface reading of turning round to face someone hides both signals.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone deafened has lost their hearing, often temporarily after a loud noise.

clue.text: Retreat on being rejected? Yes!

indicators.note: something rejected is thrown back, so the word on is read backwards

parts.note: OK is an informal yes

explanation.surface: Someone is turned down for a retreat and cheers about it.
explanation.definitionFit: A nook is a secluded corner, a place to withdraw to.

clue.text: Given new position socialist used motorway less

parts.note: red is a common label for a left-winger

indicators.note: less means without, so the motorway letter is dropped

parts.note: employed means used
M is the abbreviation for motorway, as in the M1

explanation.surface: A left-wing politician gets moved to a new post after driving less on the motorway.
explanation.definitionFit: To redeploy troops or staff is to move them to a different post or task.

clue.text: Ban bread pudding!

indicators.note: bread pudding is bread mashed and remade, so the letters of bread are reworked

explanation.surface: A food campaigner calls for bread pudding to be outlawed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bread pudding' looks like the dish; 'pudding' is the signal to rearrange the letters of 'bread'.
explanation.definitionFit: To debar is to exclude or prohibit someone formally.

clue.text: Once spectacles said to provide thrills

parts.note: ex means former, as in ex-wife

indicators.note: said signals that a word is spoken, so a sound-alike is used

parts.note: sights are spectacles worth seeing

explanation.surface: Grand shows of old were reputed to give audiences a thrill.
explanation.walkthrough: 'said' signals a sound-alike: the word for spectacles, spoken, is heard as a word meaning quotes. 'thrills' is a verb here, matching the answer's form.
explanation.definitionFit: To excite someone is to stir them with eager feeling, as a rollercoaster does.

clue.text: Notice is in French, before "letters may be kept here

parts.note: a poster is a printed notice put up in public
est is the French word for is
ante is Latin for before, as in ante-room

explanation.surface: A sign announces, half in French, that post can be held at this place.
explanation.walkthrough: Poste restante is a post-office service that holds mail until the addressee calls for it.
explanation.definitionFit: A poste restante counter keeps mail for travellers to collect in person.

clue.text: Horrid dog Enid trained for girl worried by wolf

indicators.note: training reshapes something, so the letters of these three words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A girl called Enid trained a nasty dog that harassed a wolf.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is the fairy-tale heroine stalked by the wolf on the way to her grandmother's.
explanation.definitionFit: In the fairy tale, the wolf pursues the little girl in the hooded cloak to her grandmother's cottage.

clue.text: Herb returned on time or before

indicators.note: before places the first piece ahead of the rest

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: returned means sent back, so the two words are read backwards together

parts.note: an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: A gardener says the herb came back on time or even early.
explanation.definitionFit: Oregano is a fragrant culinary herb, wild marjoram, common in Italian cooking.

clue.text: Collapse of mattress backed with frilly lace

indicators.note: backed means sent backwards, so the word is reversed

parts.note: a bed can mean a mattress

indicators.note: frilly suggests something ruffled and disordered, so the letters of lace are jumbled

explanation.surface: A mattress backed with frilly lace falls apart.
explanation.definitionFit: A debacle is a sudden humiliating failure or breakdown.

clue.text: Matching string and cord

annotationWithheld.why: Clue held as 'Matching string and cord' (5) for TWINE: 'Matching' gives TWIN and 'string' or 'cord' defines, but no word gives the final E; the clue may be misread or cut short.

clue.text: User of exercises one speaks about

indicators.note: about means around, so one piece surrounds the other

parts.note: an orator is one who speaks in public
PE, physical education, means exercises

explanation.surface: Someone who does workouts is a public speaker, it seems.
explanation.definitionFit: An operator is a person who works or runs a machine or system.

clue.text: Tax which fools people, in away

parts.note: asses are fools

indicators.note: in signals one piece put inside another

parts.note: read as 'a way', a street, abbreviated ST
men means people

explanation.surface: A levy that cons the public, in a sense.
explanation.walkthrough: The printed 'away' must be read as 'a way': a street is a way, abbreviated in addresses, and the people go inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: An assessment is the amount of tax levied after valuation.

clue.text: Singer Rose could be returning

indicators.note: could be says these letters might form something else when rearranged

explanation.surface: A singer called Rose may be making a comeback.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returning' is a noun here, the act of going back.
explanation.definitionFit: Regression is a going back to an earlier state.

clue.text: Employed in famous editor's office

indicators.note: in tells us the answer sits inside these words, across the gap between them

explanation.surface: Someone works in the office of a well-known newspaper editor.
explanation.definitionFit: Used means put to work, employed for a purpose.

clue.text: Standard weapon jargon

parts.note: par is the standard or normal level
a lance is a long weapon carried by a knight

explanation.surface: Military jargon for a standard-issue weapon.
explanation.definitionFit: Parlance is a particular way of speaking, the idiom of a group.

clue.text: Hole fixed on time

parts.note: set means fixed

explanation.surface: A hole was mended on schedule.
explanation.walkthrough: A sett is a badger's burrow.
explanation.definitionFit: A badger digs a burrow, its home in the ground.

clue.text: Companies use port for transhipment

indicators.note: transhipment moves cargo about, so the letters of the two words are moved around

explanation.surface: Shipping firms use a harbour to transfer cargo between vessels.
explanation.definitionFit: Troupes are companies of actors or dancers.

clue.text: Representatives given front door key to envoy's office

indicators.note: the front of a word is its first letter

parts.note: E is a musical key
a legation is the office or residence of a diplomatic envoy

explanation.surface: Diplomats are handed the front-door key to the embassy.
explanation.definitionFit: A delegation is a group of people sent to act for others.

clue.text: Language one volunteers to catch up with

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: to nail someone is to catch them

explanation.surface: A tongue that a volunteer needs to catch up with.
explanation.definitionFit: Italian is the Romance tongue spoken in Italy.

clue.text: Always takes job since leaving party?

indicators.note: takes means holds inside, so one piece goes into another

parts.note: ay is an old poetic word for always
a post is a job
as can mean since, as in 'as it rained'

explanation.surface: Someone is always taking jobs ever since quitting a political party.
explanation.definitionFit: Apostasy is the abandoning of one's faith or political cause.

clue.text: Certainly not thick, go without love affair

parts.note: thin is the opposite of thick

indicators.note: without means lacking, so the letter is removed

parts.note: love is zero in tennis scores, the letter O

explanation.surface: Not slow-witted, the lover walks away from a romance without love.
explanation.definitionFit: A thing can mean a romantic fling, as in 'they had a thing'.

clue.text: Reluctant look at harbour entrance

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning look
taken as written

indicators.note: the entrance to a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Someone is unwilling to view the mouth of the harbour.
explanation.definitionFit: Loath means unwilling or disinclined.

clue.text: Syndicate turns up pass book

indicators.note: in a down clue turning up means the pieces read from bottom to top

parts.note: a col is a mountain pass

explanation.surface: A syndicate presents a pass book.
explanation.definitionFit: A bloc is a group of nations or parties joined in common interest.

clue.text: Lean beef beats fish!

parts.note: tops means beats or outdoes
an ide is a freshwater fish

explanation.surface: A diner says a lean steak is better than fish.
explanation.definitionFit: Topside is a lean cut of beef from the hindquarter.

clue.text: Contributed one essay on, freckles

parts.note: lent means contributed
I is the Roman numeral one
a go is an attempt, an essay

explanation.surface: A student wrote an essay about freckles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'essay' is an attempt here, a go.
explanation.definitionFit: Lentigo is the medical term for small brown spots on the skin, like freckles.

clue.text: Seen on cricket grounds they hide, wearing spectacles

indicators.note: wearing puts one piece on the other

parts.note: sights are spectacles
screens hide things

explanation.surface: Things at cricket grounds hide people wearing glasses.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, sightscreens are large white boards behind the bowler so the batsman can see the ball.
explanation.definitionFit: Large white boards stand at the boundary of a cricket field so batsmen see the ball clearly.
